headword: {家電|かでん}{量販店|りょうはんてん}
reading: かでんりょうはんてん
gloss: big-box electronics retailer; consumer electronics store chain

definitions.gloss: big-box electronics retailer; large consumer electronics store chain
definitions.explanation: A large retail store — usually part of a chain — that sells home appliances, personal computers, cameras, smartphones, and other consumer electronics in bulk. In Japan, famous examples include ヨドバシカメラ, ビックカメラ, and {ヤマダ電機|やまだでんき}.

examples.japanese: {家電|かでん}{量販店|りょうはんてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a television at a big electronics store.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{家電|かでん}{量販店|りょうはんてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: The big electronics store in front of the station has low prices.

examples.japanese: {家電|かでん}{量販店|りょうはんてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦ポイントカード→ポイントカード：09835_pointokaado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧とお⟦{得|とく}→得：12563_toku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: At big electronics retailers, you can shop more cheaply by using a point card.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{電気屋|でんきや}さん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}って→減る：01985_heru⟧、⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{家電|かでん}{量販店|りょうはんてん}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧になってきた。
examples.english: Recently, small local electronics shops have been disappearing, and only the major big-box chains are left.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{家電|かでん}→家電：04966_kaden⟧ (home appliances, short for ⟦{家庭用|かていよう}→家庭用：16544_kateiyou⟧⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧) + ⟦{量販店|りょうはんてん}→量販店：20498_ryouhanten⟧ (mass-sales store). The second element ⟦{量販店|りょうはんてん}→量販店：20498_ryouhanten⟧ literally means "high-volume sales store" and on its own can refer to any big-box retailer; with ⟦{家電|かでん}→家電：04966_kaden⟧ attached, it specifically names the consumer-electronics variety.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {家電|かでん}{量販店|りょうはんてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy at a big electronics retailer
- ⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{家電|かでん}{量販店|りょうはんてん}: major big-box electronics chain
- {家電|かでん}{量販店|りょうはんてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧: sales staff at a big electronics retailer
- {家電|かでん}{量販店|りょうはんてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ポイントカード→ポイントカード：09835_pointokaado⟧: a big electronics retailer's point card
- {家電|かでん}{量販店|りょうはんてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店舗|てんぽ}→店舗：12481_tenpo⟧: a branch of a big electronics retailer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {電気屋|でんきや}: electronics shop — the everyday term; can refer to anything from a small independent appliance shop to a branch of a big chain. Much less formal than {家電|かでん}{量販店|りょうはんてん}.
- ⟦{家電|かでん}→家電：04966_kaden⟧⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧: same as {電気屋|でんきや}, with a more modern feel.
- ⟦デパート→デパート：01022_depaato⟧: department store — sells electronics as one category among many, with generally higher prices.
- ディスカウントストア: discount store — broader kind of big-box store selling many categories, not just electronics.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Big-box electronics retailers are a conspicuous part of the urban Japanese shopping landscape. They famously compete on point-card rebates (⟦ポイント{還元|かんげん}→ポイント還元：08798_pointokangen⟧), sometimes offering 10% or more of the purchase price back as points. The largest chains cater to international tourists as well, with tax-free counters and multilingual staff.
